component.name: Camstation
component.summary: Display RTSP cameras in configurable grid layouts

description.p: Camstation is a native Linux viewer for up to ten RTSP cameras. It saves named grid layouts, reconnects interrupted streams, and supports an unattended fullscreen kiosk mode.
Each visible camera uses an independent GStreamer pipeline. Compatible hardware decoders are preferred when available, with software decoding as a fallback.
Initial release with camera management and graphical kiosk layouts.
